env_wizard.basic_mode: Basic mode — pass --advanced to also set customer ID, config overrides, route hosts, welcome flow, and endpoint secret refs.
env_wizard.dry_run_secrets_note: Note: --dry-run previews only — the {} pasted secret value(s) you entered are NOT written to the store. Re-run without --dry-run and confirm the plan to persist them.
env_wizard.form.desc: Creates a `greentic.env-manifest.v1` manifest — the durable, re-applicable desired-state document for one environment.
env_wizard.form.title: Environment setup
env_wizard.q.bundle_id.desc: Natural key — unique within the manifest.
env_wizard.q.bundle_id.title: Bundle ID
env_wizard.q.bundle_path.desc: Local `.gtbundle`. Relative paths resolve against the manifest file's directory.
env_wizard.q.bundle_path.title: Bundle path
env_wizard.q.bundles.title: Bundles
env_wizard.q.config_overrides.desc: JSON object `{"<pack_id>": {"<key>": <value>}}`. Empty = leave untouched; `{}` = explicit clear.
env_wizard.q.config_overrides.title: Config overrides (JSON)
env_wizard.q.customer_id.desc: Billing principal — required by apply for non-`local` environments.
env_wizard.q.customer_id.title: Customer ID
env_wizard.q.environment_id.desc: Environment to apply to. `local` bootstraps with default env-pack bindings; any other ID must already exist (apply reconciles it; non-local env creation is reserved for the operator store).
env_wizard.q.environment_id.title: Environment ID
env_wizard.q.from_env.desc: Name of the variable holding the secret value (e.g. TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN) — the name, never the value. Required when the source is `env`.
env_wizard.q.from_env.title: Environment variable name
env_wizard.q.links.title: Linked bundle IDs
env_wizard.q.messaging_endpoints.desc: Messaging endpoints and their bundle links.
env_wizard.q.messaging_endpoints.title: Messaging endpoints
env_wizard.q.name.desc: Manifest-local handle and display name. Upsert key together with the provider type.
env_wizard.q.name.title: Endpoint name
env_wizard.q.path.title: Secret path
env_wizard.q.provider_type.title: Provider type
env_wizard.q.public_base_url.desc: Origin-only URL persisted on the environment (e.g. https://bots.example.com). Leave empty to keep the current value.
env_wizard.q.public_base_url.title: Public base URL
env_wizard.q.route_hosts.desc: Comma-separated host names for the route binding.
env_wizard.q.route_hosts.title: Route hosts
env_wizard.q.route_path_prefixes.desc: Comma-separated HTTP path prefixes, each starting with `/` (e.g. /legal).
env_wizard.q.route_path_prefixes.title: Route path prefixes
env_wizard.q.route_team.desc: Team for the route binding's tenant selector — set together with `route_tenant`.
env_wizard.q.route_team.title: Route team
env_wizard.q.route_tenant.desc: Tenant for the route binding's tenant selector — set together with `route_team`.
env_wizard.q.route_tenant.title: Route tenant
env_wizard.q.secret_refs.desc: Comma-separated secret refs forwarded on endpoint create.
env_wizard.q.secret_refs.title: Secret refs
env_wizard.q.secrets.desc: Dev-store secret entries. Each secret's value comes either from a named environment variable or from a value you paste in — values never go into a manifest.
env_wizard.q.secrets.title: Secrets
env_wizard.q.source.desc: `env` reads the value from a named environment variable at apply time; `paste` lets you enter the value interactively — it is stored in the env's secrets store, never in the manifest.
env_wizard.q.source.title: Secret source
env_wizard.q.trust_root_bootstrap.desc: Seed the environment trust root with the local operator key (idempotent; required once before bundles can be staged).
env_wizard.q.trust_root_bootstrap.title: Bootstrap the trust root?
env_wizard.q.webchat_gui.desc: Serve the built-in webchat console so you can chat with this environment by opening its URL in a browser. On by default for `local`; the chat path is loopback-only and unauthenticated, so keep it off for environments exposed on a public URL unless you intend it.
env_wizard.q.webchat_gui.title: Add a webchat GUI?
env_wizard.q.welcome_bundle_id.desc: Set the three welcome_* fields together (or none).
env_wizard.q.welcome_bundle_id.title: Welcome flow: bundle ID
env_wizard.q.welcome_flow_id.desc: Set the three welcome_* fields together (or none).
env_wizard.q.welcome_flow_id.title: Welcome flow: flow ID
env_wizard.q.welcome_pack_id.desc: Set the three welcome_* fields together (or none).
env_wizard.q.welcome_pack_id.title: Welcome flow: pack ID
env_wizard.secrets.choose:
For each, choose where the value comes from: a named environment
